notes: Five sources use a Fireball opener. 7VvGoqT6b-o and VrdRZZ4I2K4 use a Life Gem/Rage Gem walk; LuaPfprkevw uses zapquake.

All complete source armies are different, so the exact-composition vote is tied. The baseline selects iBpk-396MQs as a representative of the dominant Fireball plan, using the modal six Ruin Witches and five Healers with that source's full loadouts.

Only Troop Launcher is selected from iBpk-396MQs's siege inventory. Log Launcher, Siege Barracks and donated Flame Flinger are available alternatives. Multiple siege counts in other source armies also describe available inventory.

Support counts distinct cited videos describing the action and tactical role. Quantities follow the selected army; source quantities and local ordering differ. Multiple attacks from one video count once.
t=0 represents the narrated attack opening. Every after/delay=0 represents ordering where no numerical delay is stated. Citation timestamps are transcript times.

Waiting for exterior buildings, a storage or an Archer Tower to fall cannot be represented directly by the available triggers. The zero-delay opening sequence approximates that ordering and does not encode the narrated clearing wait.

The two Invisibility steps follow iBpk-396MQs's explicit pair. threat:charge approximates the exterior defenses to hide; exact footprints and distinct targets are unspecified. This approximation cannot guarantee the intended Fireball target.

Each Earthquake is a separate spell step. iBpk-396MQs narrates one after Fireball to finish X-Bows; NEvdsy6wmH4 supplies a two-Quake combination, and mTgmnznwvww supplies immediate post-Fireball area clearing. Applying both casts at building:xbow is a representative placement approximation; no source confirms that exact combined sequence.

edge:main substitutes for the narrated main entry and accessible rubble. edge:funnel and edge:left approximate layout-dependent funnel, isolated-King and cleanup positions. Exact deployment tiles, rubble locations and spell footprints are unavailable.

Ruin Witch count=all consumes the selected army's six Witches. The sources describe adding or sprinkling Witches, sometimes across both flanks, without a shared spacing or interval. Ice Golem placement follows NEvdsy6wmH4; 7VvGoqT6b-o instead deploys it before the wall break and Queen.

group_inside approximates entry or the later push. heavy_fire on Archer Queen approximates substantial damage to the main hero group; heavy_fire on Dragon Duke approximates his need for protection. These substitutions introduce no health fraction or repeat interval.

The default Queen ability follows Freeze as narrated in M4KZ_Gmmhig and the first iBpk-396MQs attack. 8WfG8dKMBAw instead prefers saving it until late tanking is gone, with an early Revenge Tower exception.

Current Rust resolves fallen-hero unit anchors at the corpse and supports surplus-spell fallback. Source-specific revival recipients and conditions still need explicit policies; the Druid/Ruin Witch intent audit confirms that corpse targeting itself is implemented.

The baseline leaves Balloon, Apprentice Warden, Headhunter and Rocket Balloon deployments, spare Invisibility and conditional Poison use unspecified because iBpk-396MQs lacks a complete shared sequence for them.

Variants changing troops, heroes, spells or equipment require the corresponding source army below; the specified variant schema has no army/loadout override. Life Gem Warden walk requires Rage Gem/Life Gem. 7VvGoqT6b-o additionally deploys two Furnaces behind Dragon Duke and uses Royal Champion instead of Barbarian King.
Only NEvdsy6wmH4 describes deploying main-army Druids. It specifies staggered healing without an interval; druid_2 uses the required delay=0 fallback, which does not encode a measured stagger.
The Electro Titan source does not narrate a complete Healer, Dragon Duke or successful Troop Launcher deployment sequence. Retained baseline actions are not independently confirmed by that video.

The Super Witch variant uses mTgmnznwvww's army. near_th uses the executor's existing default radius because the source states no radius. Skeleton placement selects the source's Monolith option; single-target Infernos are another stated option. The one-Witch-behind-Warden refinement and alternative Royal Champion placement are not imposed on this variant.

The zapquake Thrower variant records a minority plan without executable replacements. LuaPfprkevw supplies two Earthquakes, six Lightning, a four-Healer walk, one funnel Thrower, a 20-30 second Warden wait, King/Queen and four following Ruin Witches, but no named zap target or main Thrower deployment. Those missing instructions prevent a complete literal replacement.
